new_claims.statement: For A=[[a,b^T],[b,C]], u=b/||b||, D=P_{u^perp} C P_{u^perp}|_{u^perp}, if s_3(A)>=s>0 and |a|<s then ||D||>=s.
For the original residual product vector W, an eigenvector v of D with |lambda|>=s yields orthonormal u,v and joint marginal density ||p_(<u,W>,<v,W>)||_infinity<=2 by Livshyts-Paouris-Pivovarov.

mathematical_change: Every unresolved outer heavy star in the designated partner reduction now has beta>1/512, a transverse residual curvature |lambda|>=1, an exact zero coupling from that transverse direction to its orthogonal residual complement, and a two-dimensional LPP marginal cap <=2 before conditioning.
unpaid_implication: Prove a dependence-safe translation-uniform density bound for Q=aX^2+2 beta XY+cY^2+2 alpha YZ+lambda Z^2+2YT+R0 under |a|<1/512, beta>1/512, |lambda|>=1, joint density cap p_(Y,Z)<=2, while preserving the common original-product provenance of (Y,Z,T,R0); separately handle the post-pivot residual-heavy-star alternative.
